courses.subject: Physics
courses.title: The force you can't see
courses.hook: Rub a balloon on your head — why does your hair follow it up?
courses.lead: You can't touch it or see it, but it is definitely there. Find out what electricity actually is.

courses.subject: Physics
courses.title: Where will it land?
courses.hook: Why does a basketball arc? What changes when you change the angle?
courses.lead: Throw it, roll it, drop it — and find the one rule behind all of it.

courses.subject: Physics
courses.title: Wobbles and waves
courses.hook: Why does the timing of your push matter so much on a swing?
courses.lead: Start with a spring and end at sound and light. Everything that repeats is family.

courses.subject: Physics
courses.title: What light really is
courses.hook: Is light a particle or a wave? What if there isn't one answer?
courses.lead: From lenses to the experiment that turned physics upside down a century ago.

courses.subject: Chemistry
courses.title: Inside the atom
courses.hook: Split an atom and what falls out? And is it really mostly empty in there?
courses.lead: Build elements proton by proton, then watch a nucleus come apart.

courses.subject: Physics
courses.title: The strange quantum world
courses.hook: Nothing is decided until you look — what does that even mean?
courses.lead: Start with a coin toss and end where common sense breaks. No equations.

courses.subject: Earth science
courses.title: How the universe turns
courses.hook: Why doesn't the Moon fall into Earth? What if it is falling, constantly?
courses.lead: Place your own planets, build a solar system, and find where orbits break.

courses.subject: Chemistry
courses.title: Three faces of matter
courses.hook: Ice, water, steam — same thing or different things?
courses.lead: Turn up the heat, apply pressure, and learn to see individual molecules.

courses.subject: Chemistry
courses.title: What happens when you mix
courses.hook: Why does lemon juice fizz when it meets baking soda?
courses.lead: Measure pH, balance equations, and count what's left over.

courses.subject: Math
courses.title: A fraction is division
courses.hook: Three pizzas shared by four people — how much each?
courses.lead: Stop seeing a number over a number. Start seeing an amount.

courses.subject: Math
courses.title: A feel for ratios
courses.hook: Two packs of noodles take 1L of water. How much for three?
courses.lead: Ratio isn't arithmetic, it's a feel. We start by matching them by eye.

courses.subject: Math
courses.title: Speaking in graphs
courses.hook: What does a "steep" slope actually mean?
courses.lead: Move between equation and picture until changing a number moves the line in your head.

courses.subject: Biology
courses.title: Living things and the Earth
courses.hook: One island ends up all white rabbits, another all brown. What decided it?
courses.lead: Scale up from what crosses a cell membrane to the temperature of a planet.

courses.subject: Math
courses.title: Getting friendly with numbers
courses.hook: How much bigger is 7 than 3? What does "by 4" actually mean?
courses.lead: Count, compare, pair up. Every bit of math starts here.

force-unseen.title: Why a balloon pulls your hair
force-unseen.hook: Nothing happened before you rubbed it. What changed?

force-unseen.title: The invisible map around a charge
force-unseen.hook: Put down one charge and the space around it is already different?

force-unseen.title: Double the distance — what happens to the force?
force-unseen.hook: Half? Or a lot more than half?

force-unseen.title: Move a magnet, make electricity
force-unseen.hook: What if this one thing is all a power station does?

fraction.title: Three pizzas, four people
fraction.hook: What if the fraction bar is really a division sign?

fraction.title: Why multiplying works and adding doesn't
fraction.hook: You did the same thing to the top and the bottom — so why did the value change?

fraction.title: When the top is bigger than the bottom
fraction.hook: What if 8/3 isn't a mistake at all?

fraction.title: Many ways to build the same fraction
fraction.hook: What if there's more than one way to make one half?

fraction.title: Different face, same number
fraction.hook: Can you spot the same number hiding in a picture, a fraction and a mixed number?
